title: Pitch after Sunset
story: Before the amateur ensemble recorded, Karim retuned the piano twice because the hall cooled after sunset and the pitch dropped. The conductor wanted one take, so the players sat in silence while Karim worked. He finished with three minutes spare and warned that a long pause would let the strings drift. They recorded without stopping. The recording was imperfect, but the drift he feared never arrived.
